I am currently a 2nd year Computer Science and Engineering student. I have been programming since age 12, starting with game development and expanding into systems programming. I build low-level systems, Git engines, network protocols, local AI pipelines, and compilers.

## Skills
- **Languages:** C++, Go, Rust, Java, Python, C, Assembly, Godot
- **Tools & Infra:** Git, Linux / POSIX, Ollama, REST APIs

## Featured Projects
- **Rugit:** Custom version control engine built in Rust replicating Git's plumbing architecture, SHA-1/Zlib object storage, binary `.git/index` staging parser, and Git Smart HTTP wire protocol.
- **qLog:** Terminal user interface built in Go using Charm Bubble Tea, integrating a local dual-model AI pipeline via Ollama (Qwen & Gemma) for automated agenda summary generation.
- **OllaNews:** Data pipeline built in Python/Flask to aggregate Google News feeds, extract raw HTML using Trafilatura, and generate single-paragraph article summaries locally via Ollama.
- **Wimp:** Native Android app in Kotlin using Jetpack Compose and CameraX to process raw YUV camera frame bytes for real-time luminance tracking and plant taxonomy identification.
- **16-Bit Assembler:** Lightweight assembler written in C compiling text assembly mnemonics into executable binary machine code for a custom 42-instruction architecture.

## Experience
- **Game Development Intern at Darkcity Atelier** (Feb 2026 – May 2026): Sole engineer for a native Android mobile game, writing 10k+ lines of GDScript across 5 core gameplay systems.
- **Software Club Lead at G Electra Software Club** (Jul 2025 – Present): Led engineering team across 14 software releases over 14 months.
